signal: IMPLAN introduced its Forward Linkages Suite, the first tool for downstream economic analysis showing how price shifts, tariffs, and industry contributions ripple through the economy.

email.body1:
David, saw IMPLAN launch the Forward Linkages Suite, your first tool for downstream economic analysis.

A new capability like that usually opens more in-market accounts across consulting and economic development than a team can reach before the quarter closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for IMPLAN off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for IMPLAN.

When a new product expands the addressable market, most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to capture it. The gap surfaces late, and recovering a quarter is far harder than planning for it up front.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings IMPLAN needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for IMPLAN.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IMPLAN's reply rate likely compares to peer analytics-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
David, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product launch keeps a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an analytics-software motion? I'll tailor it to IMPLAN either way.
